nw: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this exact nw crop of an existing CyberHell game map. Repaint ONLY surface texture details at 1536x1024 or higher, adding genuinely fine new detail (basalt grain, gold engraving, metal rivets, crystal facets, lava crust, water ripples). The entire reference crop must fill the output edge to edge, with original aspect rescaled to the output canvas. Keep exact normalized coordinates and silhouettes of EVERY existing object, paving symbol, bridge, stairs, wall, river/lava shoreline, crystal and dock. Do not crop or extend the scene. Same camera, palette and illumination. No new objects or buildings, no food/canteen, no characters, no labels. Preserve structural edges meticulously: this is a registered production terrain texture whose collision must remain unchanged. Give it crisp painted game-art detail within the existing outlines, not a redesign.
